mentions.name: Likely-correctness study series
mentions.description: A written study series on likely-correctness; the current work is a second-part study on how to write likely-correct studies, following an earlier study on how to create likely-correct software, published on the Osequi studies site.

I'm writing a study about how to write likely-correct studies ... :)
